thread:
maria-partnerships: Quick heads-up — we're lining up the partner handoff for the new eu-west-3 rollout. Need confirmation on marketplace SKU entitlement, peering windows, and any hard capacity quotas from the partner by EOD Tues. Will be coordinating joint announcement after we lock capacity.

kevin-cloud-ops: Do we have the target QPS and concurrent inference numbers we want reserved? I can translate that into GPU quota requests.

maria-partnerships: Target is 6k reqs/min steady-state, 3k concurrent streams at p95. Peak bursts could hit ~12k reqs/min for promo windows. If partner can pre-entitle ~1.5x steady that's ideal.

raj-partner-eng: From partner side — they need the exact SKU IDs we want in marketplace so they can map quotas. Can you paste the SKU list? Also, billing onboarding needs the tenant ID for entitlement.

maria-partnerships: SKU IDs: rwinf.gpu.v4.large, rwinf.gpu.v4.xlarge, rwinf.dedicated.pool100. Tenant for entitlements: 44-712-az (we'll send secure copy).

oliver-sre: Networking notes: peering window is usually 2–4 hours. We need to schedule NAT rules and prefix whitelists. Also confirm egress rates per AZ — partner asks for 10Gbps per zone baseline.

kevin-cloud-ops: Noted. I'll open quota ticket with partner ops and the cloud provider with these numbers (+10% buffer). Suggest fallback routing to eu-west-2 if provisioning lags — can toggle via routing policy.

raj-partner-eng: Partner confirms they can pre-entitle up to 2x steady for the first 30 days, but they need the SKU mapping and a signed entitlement form. They also want a joint runway doc for scale tests.

maria-partnerships: I'll draft the entitlement form and runway doc today. @sudha-sales can you confirm the go-to-market window so the partner knows when press traffic might spike?

sudha-sales: We're targeting a soft launch with select customers next Wed, public announcement two weeks after. We'll provide expected customer list and projected traffic per customer by EOD Monday.

kevin-cloud-ops: Opening ticket: https://tickets.internal/INC-9012 (partner quota + peering). Adding partner ops and cloud provider. Please add any missing requirements to the ticket.

deploy-bot: Deployment checklist created: https://ci.internal/checklists/region-rollout-eu-west-3 (status: draft).

oliver-sre: For the scale tests, please schedule a 2-hour window with low noise (preferably Sat morning). We'll need test creds and sample prompts to validate KV cache behavior.

maria-partnerships: Action items: 1) I draft entitlement & runway doc (owner: maria) — due Mon EOD. 2) Kevin opens/progresses quota tickets (owner: kevin) — initial ticket created. 3) Raj to collect partner-signed entitlement + SKU confirmation (owner: raj) — due Mon. 4) Sudha to share launch cadence & customer list (owner: sudha) — due Mon. 5) Oliver to schedule scale window and test plan (owner: oliver) — due Tue.

raj-partner-eng: Will confirm SKU mapping + signed form by Monday.

kevin-cloud-ops: I put a placeholder for fallback routing in the ticket and added eu-west-2 as failover. Also asking partner for peering maintenance SLA.

sudha-sales: Added the launch timeline to the shared deck.

maria-partnerships: Great — let's reconvene Tue 09:30 PT for a quick sync after partner confirms entitlements. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:

oliver-sre: Thanks — will have test plan ready.

deploy-bot: Reminder: please attach signed entitlement to the ticket before approving marketplace SKUs.
